candidates.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to robots, automation, and mechanical intelligence.
This vector represents physical or conceptual infrastructure, systems, and organized facilities.
This vector represents the concept of utilization and the action of using across multiple languages and grammatical forms.
These tokens represent adjectives conveying specificity, reality, or exactness.
This vector represents modal verbs of possibility, ability, and obligation across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of labor, employment, and occupational work across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents the quantification concept of indefinite plural quantity, specifically corresponding to words meaning "some" or "several" across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on computing hardware, machinery, and digital or mechanical devices.
This vector represents adverbial intensifiers and degree modifiers across multiple languages.
This vector represents the concept of capability, competence, and potential, along with their negative counterparts.
